fields.name: Tech Company
fields.tagline: SaaS enterprise with high-velocity releases & rigorous cybersecurity defenses.
fields.description: A fast-paced cloud software organization balancing continuous delivery with strict threat monitoring, zero-trust network boundaries, and an active Security Operations Center (SOC).

fields.name: Startup
fields.tagline: High-growth early-stage venture where agility and broad ownership are vital.
fields.description: A dynamic startup environment with a small, cross-disciplinary team moving quickly to achieve product-market fit while managing scarce resources and rapid feature iteration.

fields.name: Corporate Office
fields.tagline: Multinational enterprise driven by governance, compliance, and matrix hierarchies.
fields.description: An established corporate firm characterized by formal change-management boards, departmental hand-offs, regulatory reporting, and cross-functional steering committees.

fields.name: Hospital / Healthcare
fields.tagline: Critical medical center balancing clinical urgency, patient safety, and HIPAA compliance.
fields.description: A 24/7 healthcare ecosystem where clinical decisions, patient telemetry systems, Electronic Health Records (EHR), and patient privacy intersect with immediate life-safety consequences.

fields.name: Product Manager
fields.tagline: Defines product vision, feature priorities, and business trade-offs.
fields.description: Bridges business strategy, customer needs, and technical execution. Responsible for defining roadmaps, writing acceptance criteria, and prioritizing security/stability versus market velocity.
responsibilities: Roadmap definition & feature backlog grooming
User journey validation and stakeholder alignment
Release scope sign-off and ROI prioritization
Balancing technical debt against new feature shipping

fields.name: UX / UI Designer
fields.tagline: Crafts intuitive, accessible, and human-centered digital experiences.
fields.description: Translates complex user workflows into clean, accessible interfaces. Ensures security friction (like MFA and session expiry warnings) does not degrade user adoption and compliance.
responsibilities: User research and wireframe prototyping
Design system component consistency
Usability testing for security workflows (e.g. 2FA, password recovery)
Accessibility (WCAG 2.1) compliance

fields.name: Frontend Developer
fields.tagline: Builds responsive client-side web architectures and interactive UIs.
fields.description: Implements modern user interfaces with pure HTML/CSS/JS or component frameworks. Defends against client-side attack vectors such as Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) and Content Security Policy (CSP) violations.
responsibilities: Client-side view implementation and state orchestration
Responsive layout rendering and cross-browser stability
Sanitizing user inputs to prevent client-side script injection
Integrating RESTful backend endpoints smoothly

fields.name: Backend Developer
fields.tagline: Architects business logic, APIs, database transactions, and data security.
fields.description: Constructs scalable server-side systems, data storage, and authenticated APIs. Safeguards against SQL injection, Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA), and race conditions in business logic.
responsibilities: API endpoint development and database schema migrations
Implementing secure authentication & granular authorization policies
Data encryption at rest and in transit
Patching vulnerable third-party dependencies in backend code

fields.name: QA / Test Engineer
fields.tagline: Validates quality, edge cases, regression suites, and security flaws.
fields.description: Ensures system reliability and functional correctness. Designs automated testing pipelines, executes regression suites, and performs dynamic testing to catch security edge cases before release.
responsibilities: Automated integration and end-to-end test execution
Edge-case discovery and bug triage documentation
Verifying security patches and boundary condition stability
Load testing and performance regression benchmarking

fields.name: DevOps / Cloud Engineer
fields.tagline: Manages CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration, and cloud infrastructure.
fields.description: Oversees Kubernetes clusters, cloud environments (AWS/GCP/Azure), and automated deployment pipelines. Enforces infrastructure-as-code, secrets management, and automated vulnerability scanning.
responsibilities: CI/CD pipeline maintenance and zero-downtime rollouts
Cloud resource provisioning via Terraform / IaC
Secrets rotation and IAM role least-privilege scoping
System observability, log aggregation, and metric alerting

fields.name: Network Engineer
fields.tagline: Protects network topology, VPC routing, firewalls, and data transport.
fields.description: Designs and defends the physical and virtual network topology. Manages subnets, VPN gateways, BGP routing, firewall access control lists (ACLs), and traffic scrubbing against volumetric DDoS attacks.
responsibilities: VPC design, subnetting, and network gateway configuration
Hardware and software firewall policy management
DDoS mitigation and edge traffic load balancing
Site-to-site VPN encryption and network packet analysis

fields.name: Cybersecurity Engineer
fields.tagline: Engineers threat defenses, application hardening, and secure architectures.
fields.description: Leads application security (AppSec) and system hardening. Performs threat modeling, architectural security reviews, cryptographic validation, and remediates critical CVEs across all engineering stacks.
responsibilities: Threat modeling for new architecture and API specifications
SAST/DAST pipeline integration and vulnerability triage
Incident response playbooks and forensic root cause analysis
Penetration testing and security code reviews

fields.name: SOC Analyst
fields.tagline: Monitors 24/7 SIEM feeds, investigates telemetry anomalies, and contains active threats.
fields.description: Acts as the first line of defense in the Security Operations Center. Investigates SIEM alerts, analyzes endpoint detection signals (EDR), tracks indicators of compromise (IOCs), and executes containment protocols.
responsibilities: Real-time SIEM event triage and anomaly verification
Containing active host infections and revoking compromised credentials
Phishing analysis and malicious payload reverse engineering
Escalating confirmed high-severity incidents to engineering teams

fields.name: Security Analyst
fields.tagline: Conducts risk assessments, vendor audits, compliance checks, and security governance.
fields.description: Evaluates organizational security risk, regulatory compliance (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR), third-party vendor certifications, and coordinates customer security questionnaires and pen-test attestations.
responsibilities: SOC 2, ISO 27001, and regulatory compliance audits
Vendor third-party risk assessments (TPRM)
Employee security awareness training and simulated phishing
Answering customer security due-diligence questionnaires

fields.name: Engineering Manager
fields.tagline: Guides team delivery, unblocks engineers, and balances velocity with security.
fields.description: Leads engineering squads, allocates sprint capacity, manages incident on-call rotations, and resolves cross-functional priority conflicts between feature velocity and technical/security health.
responsibilities: Sprint resource allocation and engineering velocity governance
Resolving cross-team dependencies and developer bottlenecks
Leading post-incident retrospectives and blameless reviews
Championing engineering culture, mentorship, and security standards

fields.name: Customer Support / IT
fields.tagline: Resolves employee IT issues, endpoint security, and front-line customer escalations.
fields.description: Manages internal workplace hardware/software provisioning (Identity & Access Management, MDM), resolves endpoint security alerts, and triages urgent bug reports coming directly from end-users.
responsibilities: Employee laptop onboarding, MDM enrollment, and IAM provisioning
Front-line triage of user-reported software glitches and login issues
Identifying potential social engineering and phishing attempts targeting staff
Escalating verified production issues to engineering on-call

fields.title: Phishing Attack
fields.task: Identify the primary owner responsible for investigating this alert, and select supporting technical roles.
fields.situation: An employee reports receiving a suspicious email containing a link that may steal company credentials.
fields.description: An employee reports receiving a suspicious email containing a link that may steal company credentials.
fields.explanation: The SOC Analyst should investigate and triage the alert, while cybersecurity and networking teams can assist with investigation, containment and technical validation.

fields.title: Web Application Vulnerability
fields.task: Designate the primary owner accountable for coordinating the vulnerability assessment and remediation lifecycle.
fields.situation: A security assessment discovers a serious vulnerability in a production web application.
fields.description: A security assessment discovers a serious vulnerability in a production web application.
fields.explanation: The Cybersecurity Engineer coordinates the security assessment and remediation process while engineering and QA teams help fix and validate the vulnerability.

fields.title: Suspicious Network Traffic
fields.task: Assign the primary owner to analyze the telemetry anomaly and determine if data exfiltration is occurring.
fields.situation: Security monitoring detects unusual outbound network traffic from an internal system.
fields.description: Security monitoring detects unusual outbound network traffic from an internal system.
fields.explanation: The SOC Analyst investigates the alert and coordinates with networking and cybersecurity teams to determine whether the traffic represents a security incident.

fields.title: Phishing Incident Response
fields.task: Route the incident response through the exact operational sequence required to contain the threat and notify leadership.
fields.situation: Multiple employees have clicked an urgent malicious link in a targeted spear-phishing email.
fields.description: Multiple employees have clicked an urgent malicious link in a targeted spear-phishing email.
fields.explanation: Initial report begins at IT Helpdesk, gets triaged by SOC for telemetry verification, analyzed by Cybersecurity for threat payload, isolated by Network Engineering at firewall/DNS level, and escalated to Engineering Manager for organizational oversight.

fields.title: Web Security Vulnerability
fields.task: Route the vulnerability remediation through the engineering lifecycle to ensure secure patching and quality verification.
fields.situation: A critical injection and authorization flaw was discovered in the core production web application.
fields.description: A critical injection and authorization flaw was discovered in the core production web application.
fields.explanation: Cybersecurity Engineer coordinates the security assessment and remediation process while engineering and QA teams help fix, deploy, and validate the vulnerability before manager approval.

fields.title: Suspicious Network Activity
fields.task: Establish the proper routing sequence to isolate the host, analyze the attack vector, and remediate the underlying system.
fields.situation: An internal host server is observed initiating unapproved outbound data connections to an unknown external server.
fields.description: An internal host server is observed initiating unapproved outbound data connections to an unknown external server.
fields.explanation: SOC Analyst flags the anomaly, Cybersecurity conducts deeper malware/threat forensics, Network Engineer applies ACL traffic blocking, DevOps isolates/rebuilds the affected instance, and Engineering Manager reviews operational impact.

fields.title: Ransomware Incident
fields.task: Establish cross-functional ownership and communication flow across security, networking, infrastructure, and leadership.
fields.situation: Ransomware indicators appear on a staging cluster, threatening to propagate laterally to corporate cloud assets. Cross-functional containment must be coordinated rapidly without disrupting live client workloads.
fields.description: Ransomware indicators appear on a staging cluster, threatening to propagate laterally to corporate cloud assets. Cross-functional containment must be coordinated rapidly without disrupting live client workloads.
fields.explanation: The SOC Analyst leads initial detection and triage, Cybersecurity Engineer directs infection forensics, Network Engineer severs lateral communication channels, DevOps isolates and verifies immutable backups, and Engineering Manager maintains executive visibility.

fields.title: Major Security Vulnerability
fields.task: Facilitate a balanced cross-functional collaboration flow between security, engineering, QA, and leadership.
fields.situation: A zero-day exploit in our customer portal is discovered on the eve of a major marketing release. Product leadership wants to launch, while security mandates containment.
fields.description: A zero-day exploit in our customer portal is discovered on the eve of a major marketing release. Product leadership wants to launch, while security mandates containment.
fields.explanation: Cybersecurity defines the threat criteria and safe guardrails, Backend dev drafts the targeted patch, DevOps stages an isolated canary deployment, QA runs regression security suites, and Engineering Manager aligns product delivery with security.

fields.title: Customer Data Security Incident
fields.task: Orchestrate communication flow and multi-team collaboration to respond effectively to customer data compromise.
fields.situation: An anomalous data exfiltration event compromised confidential customer billing records. The incident response requires forensic investigation, database key rotation, network boundary review, and executive communications.
fields.description: An anomalous data exfiltration event compromised confidential customer billing records. The incident response requires forensic investigation, database key rotation, network boundary review, and executive communications.
fields.explanation: SOC Analyst captures telemetry of the data egress, Cybersecurity Engineer leads the forensic root-cause investigation, Backend Developer rotates API secrets and seals query loopholes, Network Engineer verifies egress traffic blocks, and Engineering Manager coordinates executive and legal disclosure.

fields.title: Production Database Disk Full During Seed Pitch
fields.task: Identify who in the lean startup team owns immediate operational database containment.
fields.situation: The primary database disk space reaches 99.8% capacity right as angel investors are testing the live checkout flow.
fields.description: The primary database disk space reaches 99.8% capacity right as angel investors are testing the live checkout flow.
fields.explanation: In an early-stage startup, the Full-Stack Developer directly owns infrastructure operations and database resizing.

fields.title: Viral Traffic Spike & Payment Gateway Glitch
fields.task: Route the incident across marketing communication, engineering throughput, and financial reconciliation.
fields.situation: A social influencer shoutout drives 30,000 simultaneous visitors, causing Stripe payment webhooks to timeout.
fields.description: A social influencer shoutout drives 30,000 simultaneous visitors, causing Stripe payment webhooks to timeout.
fields.explanation: Growth Marketer communicates status to incoming traffic, Full-Stack Dev resolves queue concurrency, Ops verifies failed transactions, and CEO aligns stakeholders.

fields.title: Strategic Pivot vs. Customer Support Crisis
fields.task: Collaborate across the leadership and engineering team to balance runway extension with core customer retention.
fields.situation: With 3 months of cash runway remaining, the Founder wants to pivot to an AI copilot, but existing paying users demand critical bug fixes.
fields.description: With 3 months of cash runway remaining, the Founder wants to pivot to an AI copilot, but existing paying users demand critical bug fixes.
fields.explanation: Ops outlines remaining cash burn, Growth analyzes retention churn, Developer estimates pivot feasibility, and CEO leads unified decision.

fields.title: Unencrypted Customer PII in Legacy File Share
fields.task: Determine primary ownership and immediate regulatory containment protocol.
fields.situation: An internal compliance review uncovers 500,000 historical customer records stored in an unencrypted network share accessible across departments.
fields.description: An internal compliance review uncovers 500,000 historical customer records stored in an unencrypted network share accessible across departments.
fields.explanation: Compliance & Risk Officer owns regulatory data governance, breach notification obligations, and formal data freezes.

fields.title: Critical Procurement SLA Delay for Enterprise Tools
fields.task: Route the escalation through appropriate corporate matrix governance channels.
fields.situation: Development teams are blocked because IDE licenses and cloud credits have been delayed in corporate procurement for 3 weeks.
fields.description: Development teams are blocked because IDE licenses and cloud credits have been delayed in corporate procurement for 3 weeks.
fields.explanation: Operations flags the SLA breach, Business Analyst calculates productivity impact, Compliance audits vendor terms, and Project Director secures executive waiver.

fields.title: Change Advisory Board (CAB) ERP Deployment Standoff
fields.task: Lead multi-department collaboration to resolve compliance requirements without missing the scheduled maintenance window.
fields.situation: The CAB rejects an enterprise ERP migration 12 hours before cutover due to missing rollback verification tests from finance.
fields.description: The CAB rejects an enterprise ERP migration 12 hours before cutover due to missing rollback verification tests from finance.
fields.explanation: Business Analyst provides synthetic test verification, Compliance validates regulatory audit trails, Operations prepares rollback triggers, and Project Director chairs emergency CAB approval.

fields.title: ICU Telemetry Network Ransomware Alert
fields.task: Designate the primary technical owner accountable for immediate clinical subnet isolation.
fields.situation: Suspicious ransom notes appear on nursing station terminals monitoring ICU cardiac telemetry data.
fields.description: Suspicious ransom notes appear on nursing station terminals monitoring ICU cardiac telemetry data.
fields.explanation: The Clinical Systems Administrator immediately isolates the hospital network switch to prevent malware spread, while Biomedical Engineers and Nursing staff verify patient monitor continuity.

fields.title: Mass Casualty Triage and Acute Bed Allocation
fields.task: Route the patient flow and equipment logistics according to clinical urgency protocols.
fields.situation: A major multi-vehicle accident brings 25 acute trauma patients to an Emergency Department with only 8 open bays.
fields.description: A major multi-vehicle accident brings 25 acute trauma patients to an Emergency Department with only 8 open bays.
fields.explanation: Head Nurse leads clinical triage color coding, Biomedical Engineer rushes portable ventilators, IT ensures rapid patient registration, and CMO coordinates surge capacity.

fields.title: Urgent Medical Device Security Patch vs. Surgical Schedule
fields.task: Lead multi-disciplinary collaboration between clinical surgery, nursing, biomedical engineering, and IT.
fields.situation: A critical zero-day vulnerability in operating room infusion pumps requires urgent patching, but 8 major surgeries are scheduled for today.
fields.description: A critical zero-day vulnerability in operating room infusion pumps requires urgent patching, but 8 major surgeries are scheduled for today.
fields.explanation: IT provides threat risk window, Biomedical Engineering stages pre-patched reserve pumps for active surgeries, Head Nurse coordinates staggered ward transitions, and Chief Medical Officer signs off on patient safety assurance.

fields.option_text: SOC Analyst (Primary Owner) — Triage the reported email, inspect headers, and initiate alert containment.
fields.feedback_rationale: Optimal: The SOC Analyst is the primary investigator for incoming threat telemetry and employee security reports. They isolate suspicious URLs and trigger containment.

fields.option_text: Customer Support / IT — Tell the employee to mark the email as spam and take no further technical action.
fields.feedback_rationale: Suboptimal: Frontline IT should escalate potential credential harvesters to SOC rather than brushing it off as ordinary spam.

fields.option_text: Product Manager — Schedule a quarterly training seminar to address workplace email hygiene.
fields.feedback_rationale: Incorrect: Active threats require real-time technical triage, not future roadmap scheduling.

fields.option_text: Frontend Developer — Check if our website login page is functioning properly.
fields.feedback_rationale: Incorrect: An inbound phishing email targeting employee mailboxes has no relationship to public website frontend code.

fields.option_text: Cybersecurity Engineer (Primary Owner) — Coordinate threat assessment, define remediation scope, and guide engineering on secure patch standards.
fields.feedback_rationale: Optimal: The Cybersecurity Engineer owns overall vulnerability assessment and remediation coordination across engineering stakeholders.

fields.option_text: UX / UI Designer — Redesign the vulnerable page so users cannot find the affected form field.
fields.feedback_rationale: Security through obscurity does not resolve application vulnerabilities. Direct backend code remediation is required.

fields.option_text: Backend Developer — Push an immediate untested hotfix directly to production servers without security review.
fields.feedback_rationale: Risky: While backend devs implement the patch, doing so without coordination or QA validation risks service outages and incomplete fixes.

fields.option_text: Customer Support / IT — Tell users that the web application is undergoing routine scheduled maintenance.
fields.feedback_rationale: Misleading and ineffective: Falsifying maintenance notices fails to remediate the underlying flaw.

fields.option_text: SOC Analyst (Primary Owner) — Triage the network telemetry alert, correlate flow logs, and determine potential compromise.
fields.feedback_rationale: Optimal: The SOC Analyst monitors continuous SIEM and IDS feeds, triage anomalies, and confirms whether traffic constitutes an incident.

fields.option_text: Engineering Manager — Demand a written report from all developers explaining their recent download history.
fields.feedback_rationale: Ineffective: Interrogating developers manually without log telemetry analysis wastes time during an active anomaly.

fields.option_text: QA / Test Engineer — Write an automated test case to see if the anomaly replicates itself.
fields.feedback_rationale: Misaligned: Live network anomalies require immediate operational triage, not regression test automation.

fields.option_text: DevOps / Cloud Engineer — Power down all cloud servers across all availability zones immediately.
fields.feedback_rationale: Disproportionate: Uncoordinated server shutdown destroys production business continuity and volatile forensic evidence in RAM.

fields.option_text: Customer Support / IT → SOC Analyst → Cybersecurity Engineer → Network Engineer → Engineering Manager
fields.feedback_rationale: Correct Workflow Order: Seamless escalation from frontline intake to telemetry triage, threat analysis, perimeter blocking, and management sign-off.

fields.option_text: Engineering Manager → UX / UI Designer → Frontend Developer → Customer Support / IT → SOC Analyst
fields.feedback_rationale: Flawed sequence: Involves UI design in an active security breach and delays SOC response.

fields.option_text: SOC Analyst → QA / Test Engineer → Product Manager → Network Engineer
fields.feedback_rationale: Omission: Missing Cybersecurity Engineer and frontline IT containment.

fields.option_text: Cybersecurity Engineer → Backend Developer → DevOps / Cloud Engineer → QA / Test Engineer → Engineering Manager
fields.feedback_rationale: Correct Workflow Order: Security specs the fix, Backend patches code, DevOps orchestrates deployment pipelines, QA verifies zero regressions, and EM authorizes release.

fields.option_text: Backend Developer → Customer Support / IT → Product Manager → QA / Test Engineer
fields.feedback_rationale: Omits Cybersecurity guidance and cloud deployment infrastructure steps.

fields.option_text: DevOps / Cloud Engineer → UX / UI Designer → Frontend Developer → Engineering Manager
fields.feedback_rationale: Misrouted: Web vulnerabilities in backend databases cannot be solved by UI design.

fields.option_text: SOC Analyst → Cybersecurity Engineer → Network Engineer → DevOps / Cloud Engineer → Engineering Manager
fields.feedback_rationale: Correct Workflow Order: Triage → Threat Analysis → Traffic Isolation → Infrastructure Rebuild → Leadership Governance.

fields.option_text: Network Engineer → Customer Support / IT → Product Manager → Backend Developer
fields.feedback_rationale: Bypasses SOC investigation and cloud infrastructure management.

fields.option_text: Customer Support / IT → QA / Test Engineer → Frontend Developer → Engineering Manager
fields.feedback_rationale: Completely erroneous routing for network perimeter incidents.

fields.option_text: Collaborative Protocol: SOC Analyst alerts Cybersecurity Engineer for strain analysis; Network Engineer restricts VLAN routing; DevOps secures backup snapshots; Engineering Manager coordinates cross-team communication.
fields.feedback_rationale: Exemplary Collaboration: Full multi-team synchronization containing lateral movement while safeguarding backup integrity.

fields.option_text: Siloed Action: SOC Analyst attempts to decrypt ransomware alone without informing Network or DevOps teams.
fields.feedback_rationale: Failure to collaborate: Single-person silo allows malware to spread laterally to cloud repositories.

fields.option_text: DevOps wipes all hard drives without coordinating with Security or verifying forensic artifacts.
fields.feedback_rationale: Destroys critical forensic indicators and risks immediate reinfection from untracked rootkits.

fields.option_text: Collaborative Flow: Cybersecurity Engineer defines containment patch; Backend Developer patches service; DevOps deploys to canary; QA executes rapid regression; Engineering Manager synchronizes release timeline.
fields.feedback_rationale: Optimal Cross-Functional Alignment: Balances rapid delivery with rigorous security validation without unilateral shutdowns.

fields.option_text: Engineering Manager overrides Security warnings and pushes vulnerable code to meet the marketing deadline.
fields.feedback_rationale: Reckless negligence: Willingly deploying known zero-days causes breaches, fines, and brand destruction.

fields.option_text: Cybersecurity Engineer revokes all AWS developer keys unilaterally without notifying team leads.
fields.feedback_rationale: Sabotages organizational trust and halts all engineering velocity without solving the code flaw.

fields.option_text: Collaborative Flow: SOC Analyst maps exfiltration timeline; Cybersecurity Engineer leads forensics; Backend Developer revokes keys and fixes data leak; Network Engineer audits traffic; Engineering Manager coordinates leadership briefing.
fields.feedback_rationale: Gold standard incident response: Technical containment, forensic preservation, and structured leadership briefing.

fields.option_text: Backend Developer quietly deletes affected customer records from the database to hide the evidence.
fields.feedback_rationale: Criminal concealment: Destroying evidence violates compliance laws and breaches ethical obligations.

fields.option_text: Engineering Manager sends a generic email to all customers before any forensic facts have been verified.
fields.feedback_rationale: Premature panic: Public statements before forensic confirmation cause reputational damage.

fields.option_text: Full-Stack Developer — Purge temporary cache logs and resize the cloud volume with automated storage expansion.
fields.feedback_rationale: Direct ownership: Resolves the immediate storage bottleneck in minutes.

fields.option_text: Operations Lead — Submit a purchase request for server hard drives next week.
fields.feedback_rationale: Too bureaucratic for an active production crash.

fields.option_text: Growth Marketer → Full-Stack Developer → Operations Lead → Founder & CEO
fields.feedback_rationale: Smooth cross-functional delegation keeping customers informed while fixing the infrastructure.

fields.option_text: Founder & CEO → Operations Lead → Growth Marketer
fields.feedback_rationale: Omission: Ignores the developer needed to fix the broken webhook queue.

fields.option_text: Collaborative Strategy: Ops reviews runway burn; Growth evaluates user churn; Dev estimates micro-pivot MVP; Founder sets unified roadmap.
fields.feedback_rationale: Balances commercial realities with pragmatic product innovation.

fields.option_text: Founder unilaterally cancels all customer support and fires developers who question the pivot.
fields.feedback_rationale: Destructive leadership that guarantees startup failure.

fields.option_text: Compliance & Risk Officer — Issue an immediate network isolation freeze and initiate formal GDPR/privacy remediation.
fields.feedback_rationale: Fulfills legal fiduciary duties and prevents further data exposure.

fields.option_text: Operations Manager — Ignore the finding because the audit was only internal.
fields.feedback_rationale: Severe compliance violation carrying massive regulatory penalties.

fields.option_text: Operations Manager → Enterprise Business Analyst → Compliance & Risk Officer → Project Director
fields.feedback_rationale: Navigates corporate governance channels effectively using structured business impact data.

fields.option_text: Enterprise Business Analyst → Operations Manager
fields.feedback_rationale: Incomplete: Fails to escalate to decision-makers with budget authority.

fields.option_text: Collaborative Resolution: Business Analyst furnishes test verification; Compliance validates auditability; Operations stages rollback safeguards; Project Director reconvenes emergency CAB for signed approval.
fields.feedback_rationale: Exemplifies mature corporate leadership and change governance.

fields.option_text: Project Director deploys the software anyway in defiance of CAB governance rules.
fields.feedback_rationale: Breaches corporate policy and creates enormous rollback liabilities.

fields.option_text: Clinical Systems Administrator — Isolate affected network VLANs immediately and engage clinical staff for manual telemetry backup.
fields.feedback_rationale: Decisive technical ownership protecting human life and hospital telemetry.

fields.option_text: Head Nurse — Power off all bedside heart monitors immediately without backup verification.
fields.feedback_rationale: Life-threatening: Shutting down patient telemetry unmonitored risks patient mortality.

fields.option_text: Head Nurse / Floor Supervisor → Biomedical Equipment Engineer → Clinical Systems Administrator → Chief Medical Officer
fields.feedback_rationale: Seamless clinical protocol execution under life-or-death pressure.

fields.option_text: Chief Medical Officer → Head Nurse / Floor Supervisor
fields.feedback_rationale: Incomplete: Misses critical biomedical hardware and EHR system provisioning.

fields.option_text: Collaborative Protocol: IT identifies safe patching window; Biomedical Engineer stages pre-verified reserve pumps; Nursing coordinates room rotation; CMO authorizes surgical continuity without device risk.
fields.feedback_rationale: Harmonizes clinical life safety with device cybersecurity protection.

fields.option_text: Cancel all hospital operations for a month without clinical justification.
fields.feedback_rationale: Disproportionate and catastrophic clinical failure.
